name: surface-signal-html
description: Source-backed interactive HTML artifacts for planning, review, research, and decision workflows.

interface.longDescription: Surface Signal HTML creates temporary, self-contained HTML artifacts for plans, reviews, feature explainers, presentations, risks, roadmaps, migrations, QA triage, ADRs, and research. Each artifact is compiled from a lean source project so iteration edits structured source files, not disposable HTML output. Use $surface-signal-html as the canonical router or $s2-html as the shorthand alias; literal /s2-html is treated as a fallback text trigger.
defaultPrompt: $surface-signal-html turn this plan into an editable HTML review.
$s2-html create an approval board for these findings.
$surface-signal-html explain this feature as a walkthrough.
